name: FCC Headphone Jack Leak (Stale speculation on already released hardware)
title: Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller FCC Filing Leaks? Headphone Jack Potentially Added
body: A recent FCC filing for model BEE-008 suggests that Nintendo might be adding a 3.5mm headphone jack to the upcoming Switch 2 Pro Controller, sparking speculation among fans waiting for hardware announcements.
description: Перепечатка витоку FCC 2025 року про аудіороз'єм для контролера, який вже вийшов у червні 2025.

name: Piracy Lawsuit Repeated Report (Duplicate coverage without new facts)
title: Nintendo wins $4.5 million in Switch piracy lawsuit against subreddit moderator (Repeated Report)
body: A report reiterates that Nintendo was awarded $4.5 million in statutory damages against a prominent Reddit piracy moderator, restating court details from the prior week without new developments.
description: Повторний звіт про той самий судовий вирок без нових фактів.

name: Stale Patent Speculation (Old patent on existing hardware)
title: Nintendo patents new magnetic Joy-Con attachment mechanism for hybrid console
body: An old patent filing surfaced online discussing rail and magnetic mechanisms for detachable controllers, though no new product announcement was made.
description: Спекуляції на старих патентних заявках без анонсу.

name: GameChat Developer Interview (Fresh valuable first-party insight)
title: Nintendo reveals GameChat origins including Switch 1 prototype, started working on Switch 2 features in 2020
body: In an official interview published this week, Nintendo hardware and software developers revealed the origins of the GameChat system, explaining that early prototypes were tested during the original Switch era and development of new networking features for Switch 2 began back in 2020.
description: Свіже офіційне інтерв'ю розробників про GameChat та прототипи.

name: Nintendo Museum Special Exhibition (High priority official event)
title: Nintendo Museum announces special Zelda retrospective exhibition and exclusive hardware showcase
body: Nintendo has announced its first major special exhibition for the Nintendo Museum in Kyoto, focusing on the evolution of The Legend of Zelda with rare development materials and playable prototypes.
description: Спеціальна виставка в музеї Nintendo — пріоритетна свіжа подія компанії.

name: Metroid Prime 4 Overview (Fresh first-party gameplay showcase)
title: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond receives extensive new gameplay overview and performance breakdown
body: Nintendo has released an in-depth gameplay overview showcasing new traversal abilities, environmental scanning, and visual enhancements running at a rock-solid 60 FPS.
